content: Equations are an important part of scientific articles, but many existing machine learning methods do not easily handle them. They are challenging to work with because each is unique or nearly unique; most equations occur only once. An automatic understanding of equations, however, would significantly benefit methods for analyzing scientific literature. Useful representations of equations can help draw connections between articles, improve retrieval of scientific texts, and help create tools for exploring and navigating scientific literature.
